messages.text: The north quarry closed at 20:00 UTC.
The north quarry gate is still admitting carts.
The closure notice is posted at the office.
Two loaded carts entered after 20:00 UTC.

main_story.headline: Debate Over North Quarry Operational Hours After Reported Shutdown
main_story.lede: Discussions concerning the operational status of the north quarry revealed a significant discrepancy between posted closure times and ongoing logistical activity.
main_story.body:
Conversations centered on the compliance with the established shutdown procedures for the north quarry, particularly after 20:00 UTC. At one point, **Uma** reported that the facility had officially closed at 20:00 UTC and noted that a closure notice was posted at the office.

This official status was immediately questioned regarding physical adherence to the timeline. Minutes later, **Vik** challenged the claim of immediate cessation, stating that the north quarry gate was still admitting carts. Further discussion confirmed this discrepancy, with **Vik** pointing out specific evidence: two loaded carts entered the area after 20:00 UTC.
